params.body:
A report or a deck that is still being written has no post to hang its figures on, so its numbers came from the open web with sources outside Gentells. This lets a figure be held at its origin on its own, and lets the agent read the figures Gentells holds.

## What changes

- `bin/cite-statistics.mjs`: a plan entry without `article` and `sentence` records the statistic and its publisher and cites it nowhere. The Standard decides as before (every field, a sample size for a survey, a publisher whose terms allow a paid product, a new publisher admitted by a named person). A sentence without its post is refused. The undo table keeps what such a run made, so `--undo=<run>` removes the figure and the publisher unless something cites them by then. The summary line counts the figures recorded on their own.
- `packages/core/source-reads.mjs`: a fifth read on the agent door, `statistics`. Words in `q` must all be in the measure, population, publication, passage or publisher. Each figure comes as a reader reads it (value with unit, population and period; publisher, publication, place), with its address, the publisher's terms, whether the Standard lets it be cited and why not, and in how many posts it is cited. No names of people.
- Two plans with three figures on young people and work, each opened at its publisher on 15 November 2026:
  - `research/statistics-2026-11-15.json`: 9,155 student-self-employed in Belgium on 31 December 2025 (RSVZ, Cijfers en tendensen 2025). Terms read: reuse under CC0.
  - `research/statistics-2026-11-15-terms-open.json`: 55% of 16 to 26 year olds can imagine becoming self-employed (TUI Stiftung, Junges Europa 2026, p. 78, 8,024 asked), and the share of under-30s in new open-ended contracts, 31.8% in 2025 against 40.3% in 2024 (Securex, press release of 5 February 2026). Their terms are left empty on purpose: the TUI Stiftung site reserves all rights and the Securex press room states none. The plan is refused until a person fills them in.

The third figure measures employment contracts, not self-employment; its measure says so.

## Tests

`test/cite-statistics.test.mjs`: a figure on its own is recorded, read back, not recorded twice, and undone while a publisher another figure rests on stays; a sentence without a post and unknown terms are refused; the plan of 15 November passes dry, the terms-open plan is refused for the terms only. `test/source-reads.test.mjs`: the door lists five reads. Suite 1696/1696, `tsc` clean.

## On the box after the merge

```bash
node bin/cite-statistics.mjs research/statistics-2026-11-15.json --admitted-by=<name> --run=figures-2026-11-15 --dry
node bin/cite-statistics.mjs research/statistics-2026-11-15.json --admitted-by=<name> --run=figures-2026-11-15
```

Closes #461
params.title: Statistics that stand on their own, and a read for the agent
